en.title: Article Reader

props.lede: A component should know its own width, not the window's. We go through what that changes in card layouts and where the old media queries end up.
props.author: Kirill Dyomin

sections.heading: Why breakpoints let you down
paragraphs: A media query only knows the window width. A card that takes a third of the page and the full width of a modal gets the same set of rules, and looks like a compromise in both places.

We treated that with modifier classes for a long time: the card learned about its surroundings from a prop. Every new place needed a new modifier, and by the fortieth component nobody could keep track.

sections.heading: How a container query works
paragraphs: An element declares itself a container through container-type: inline-size, and its descendants gain access to its width. The rest works like a media query, except the reference point is the nearest container rather than the window.

One subtlety matters: a rule inside @container does not apply to the container itself. The layout has to live on an inner wrapper, otherwise the query silently does nothing — and only your eyes will catch it.
sections.callout: The cqi unit is a percentage of the container width. With it the heading size stops depending on the screen resolution and starts depending on the slot the block was put into.

sections.heading: What changed in the project
paragraphs: Props like compact and wide left the components: a card picks its own layout. The catalogue stopped lying — the thumbnail shows exactly what a reader gets on their own page.
Media queries stayed where they belong: print, dark theme and the padding of the page itself. Everything about a component is now measured from the component.

props.title: Container queries over breakpoints

en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local variables --vibeui-blog-002-*. A server component: the contents are built from the same sections as the text, and a native <details open> holds the disclosure. On a wide block a container query makes the column sticky and hides the arrow, and removes pointer-events from summary so that the contents cannot be collapsed. The headings carry an id and scroll-margin-top, and the text width is limited in ch.

items.title: Лента по темам
items.description: Архив статей строками с фильтром по рубрикам: рубрики собираются из самих записей, поэтому счётчик всегда совпадает с тем, что покажет фильтр.
items.docs: Блок самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-blog-005-*. Клиентский: "use client" ради фильтра в useState. Список рубрик выводится из массива записей через Set, счётчик считает те же записи, что покажет фильтр. Обёртка списка объявлена aria-live="polite". На широком блоке container query переносит дату и рубрику в отдельную колонку слева.

ai.usage: <Blog005 title="Все статьи по рубрикам" allLabel="Все" entries={[{ title: "…", excerpt: "…", topic: "Вёрстка", date: "4 марта 2025", readingTime: "11 мин" }]} />
ai.summary: Архив статей строками: фильтр по рубрикам со счётчиками, дата, время чтения и анонс у каждой записи. Ноль зависимостей, один файл.

сбор рубрик из самих записей: отдельный список фильтров рано или поздно разойдётся с архивом
счётчики у рубрик — они показывают объём до нажатия
aria-live у списка: смена фильтра иначе проходит незамеченной
строки вместо плиток: плитка врёт про объём архива, на экран влезает шесть карточек
aria-pressed у кнопок фильтра — активная рубрика не должна отличаться только цветом
light-dark() в палитре: компонент обязан следовать color-scheme окружения, а не носить собственную тёмную тему
прозрачную подложку по умолчанию — компонент ложится на фон страницы, а не выкладывает под себя плашку
adapt: массив entries и их рубрики
title и eyebrow над фильтром
allLabel — подпись рубрики «все»
emptyLabel, countLabel с меткой {count}, filtersLabel и акцент через проп accent
background — подложка компонента; пусто означает «без подложки», по цвету страницы
notes: Тема берётся из color-scheme. Чтобы компонент темнел вместе с системой, у проекта должно быть объявлено color-scheme: light dark на html — иначе light-dark() всегда вернёт светлую ветку.
Порядок рубрик берётся из порядка записей: блок не сортирует их по алфавиту.
Записи не сортируются по дате — приходят в том порядке, в каком лежат в массиве.
Фильтр живёт в состоянии блока: связать его с адресом страницы должен вызывающий код.
Не выносите CSS-переменные в globals.css: блок обязан оставаться одним файлом.

en.description: An article archive as rows with a topic filter: topics are derived from the entries, so the counter always matches what the filter shows.

ai.summary: An article archive as rows: a topic filter with counters, plus date, reading time and excerpt per entry. Zero dependencies, one file.
preserve: the local --vibeui-blog-005-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
deriving topics from the entries: a separate filter list drifts from the archive
the counters on the topics — they show the volume before a click
aria-live on the list: otherwise filtering passes unnoticed
rows instead of tiles: a tile grid lies about the archive size, six cards fill a screen
aria-pressed on the filter buttons — the active topic must not differ by colour alone
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself

title and eyebrow above the filter

The filter lives in block state: wiring it to the page URL is the caller's job.

en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local variables --vibeui-blog-005-*. A client component: "use client" is there for the filter in useState. The list of topics is derived from the entries array through a Set, and the counter counts the same entries the filter will show. The list wrapper is declared aria-live="polite". On a wide block a container query moves the date and the topic into a separate column on the left.

items.docs: Блок самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-blog-006-*. Серверный: хуков нет. Корень — <aside> с aria-label: это дополнение к статье, а не самостоятельный раздел. Ссылка заголовка растянута ::after на карточку, обводка держится на :focus-within. Порядковая подпись занимает место рубрики. Три колонки включаются container query.

en.description: Related articles that explain the link: every card carries a «why this one» line — a follow-up, a shared topic or the opposite conclusion.

ai.summary: A related-articles block under a piece: cards with the reason for the link, topic, reading time and a link to the archive. Zero dependencies, one file, no client JS.
preserve: the local --vibeui-blog-006-* palette — do not swap it for your theme tokens
the «why this one» line: without an explained link a related block is simply scrolled past
the <aside> with aria-label — this supplements the article, it is not its equal
the sequence caption in place of the topic: a reader who finished usually wants the follow-up
the muted background and smaller type — the block must not compete with the article
the stretched heading link and the :focus-within ring
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself
adapt: the items array and the reason text per article
title, afterTitle and the afterLabel template with its {title} placeholder — the piece just read
allLabel and the allHref link
the accent through the accent prop
background — the component background; empty means no background, taking the page colour
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
The block does not pick the articles: it renders whatever the caller passes.
The sequence caption is optional — without it the card reads as an ordinary recommendation.
Three cards is the limit: a fourth breaks the row and turns the block into another feed.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the block has to stay a single file.

en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in local variables --vibeui-blog-006-*. A server component: there are no hooks. The root is an <aside> with aria-label: this supplements the article, it is not a section in its own right. The heading link is stretched over the card with ::after, and the ring rests on :focus-within. The sequence caption takes the place of the topic. Three columns are turned on by a container query.
